title: Correct streak_event_log.dart's doc comment — the real unique index is (profileId, dayUtc, eventType), not eventTimestamp
rule: Evans (ubiquitous language consistency) / AG-8-adjacent (docs must match reality)

evidence.quote:
/// The single mutation method is [append]. Idempotency is enforced by
/// the UNIQUE `(profileId, eventTimestamp, eventType)` index on

why: The actual Drift table declares the UNIQUE composite as (profileId, dayUtc, eventType) — eventTimestamp is not part of it, and the table's own doc comment says so explicitly ('two devices writing the same logical day-event collapse to one row'). streak_event_log.dart's code is actually correct (it computes dayUtc from eventTimestamp before inserting), but its doc comment describes a different, wrong key. This class is the write path used by core/sync/merge/streak_event_merger.dart for cross-device streak-event merge — a maintainer who trusts this comment and 'optimizes' the dedup logic around eventTimestamp instead of dayUtc would break cross-device dedup and silently duplicate streak_events rows on sync, corrupting streak counts.
recommendation: Fix the doc comment to say (profileId, dayUtc, eventType), matching core/database/tables/streak_events.dart.
acceptance_criteria: streak_event_log.dart's doc comment states the same 3 columns as the @TableIndex on StreakEvents.

corrections: Quote for streak_events.dart cited at line 12; the @TableIndex block actually starts at line 13 (line 12 is the doc comment's last line). Quote text is verbatim correct, just off by one line.
